matches.rationale: No report finding covers the relayer losing gas money on many tiny withdrawals. Finding 15 is about an unbounded loop hitting the block gas limit, which is a different defect.
Finding 3 is about withdrawIds becoming reusable after a message is deleted. It does not raise collisions between 64-bit ids blocking legitimate withdrawals.
Finding 1 identifies that DeployV1 never grants WITHDRAW_AUTHORITY_ROLE to the bridge, so every claimWithdrawal reverts.
